sentences.japanese: 私はたいてい夕方シャワーを浴びます。
sentences.english: I usually take a shower in the evening.

sentences.japanese: 共産主義が崩壊したことにより、今や資本主義が「世界を支配」しようとしているという非難を浴びている。
sentences.english: As communism has collapsed, capitalism is now accused of trying to "dominate the world."

sentences.japanese: 記者は政治家に質問を浴びせた。
sentences.english: The reporter shot questions at the politician.

sentences.japanese: 花嫁は伏目がちに、満座の注目を浴びながら入場した。
sentences.english: The bride came into the room with lowered eyes and with everyone staring at her.

sentences.japanese: 花嫁は皆の視線を浴びながら部屋に入ってきた。
sentences.english: The bride came into the room, with everyone staring at her.
